mechanism: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) may reduce venlafaxine efficacy by enhancing its metabolism or interfering with monoamine potentiation; chronic high-dose B6 can cause peripheral neuropathy which may be compounded by venlafaxine's neurological effects.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy and peripheral neuropathy symptoms; avoid excessive B6 supplementation (>200 mg/day) and counsel patients on appropriate dosing.
